newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Commission to report on US veterinary negotiations.
newsitem.headline: Commission to report on US veterinary negotiations.

text.p: The European Commission will report to farm ministers on the progress of veterinary equivalence negotiations with the United States next week, a spokesman for the European Union's Dutch Presidency said on Thursday.

A U.S. delegation is due to meet EU negotiators in a week's time in a bid to conclude negotiations before the April 1 deadline set by the Commission in December, when it extended existing rules for three months from January 1.
Under new rules due to have been in force from January 1 all imports would have to undergo veterinary inspections and tougher controls.
"There are still some difficulties and the Commission will give an explanation," the presidency spokesman said.
The U.S. is still hopeful of reaching an agreement in time to avert a serious transatlantic trade dispute, a U.S. source said.
